features: Fix v0.2.02 false-positive 7x24 filtering: any 5x7, 5x24, delayed-open/early-close, or Korea 5x7 tag now overrides a raw trade_time_7_24 tag and excludes the symbol from analysis.
R2 continues to preserve the complete Pionex US-stock/RWA universe; the daily sync now also stores one effective trade_tag per symbol plus trade_tag_map metadata.
US-stock analysis accepts only explicit/pure trade_time_7_24 entries; explicit non-7x24 tags cannot be re-added by raw future_tags.
No chart, CCI, probability, memo, filter, research, or unrelated UI logic is changed.
